subject: Cerulean Systems: Private Deploy - connectivity & on-prem handoff
messages: From: Maya Reddy To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai Cc: alex.chen@ceruleansystems.com Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700 Subject: Re: Cerulean Systems: Private Deploy - connectivity & on-prem handoff Hi Camila — Thanks for sending over the initial onboarding packet. Quick question before we lock dates: our security team is asking for the VPC CIDR plan you expect for the private endpoints and whether Redwood will require public egress for the on-prem appliance during installation. Can you confirm? We also want to make sure our proxy rules allow the healthcheck and metrics traffic. I attached a trimmed diagram of our current network layout (see cerulean_vpc_diagram.png) — the staging cluster sits in 10.40.0.0/16 and we prefer not to overlap. Maya Director, Cloud Operations Cerulean Systems From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai To: Maya Reddy Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 11:04:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Cerulean Systems: Private Deploy - connectivity & on-prem handoff Hi Maya — Great questions, thanks for the diagram. Short answers up front: - Preferred Redwood private endpoint CIDR: 10.50.0.0/16 (can be adjusted if you have constraints). - On-prem appliance: installation requires outbound TLS to our control plane (redwood-control.redwood.ai:443) for enrollment and health reporting; this is egress-only and can be routed through your existing proxy (we support CONNECT tunneling). - Healthcheck/metrics: ports 443 (TLS) and 12345 (metrics over TLS) are used; we can consolidate metrics into the TLS endpoint if you want fewer firewall rules. Proposed next steps: 1) Quick network alignment call (30 min) to agree CIDRs and peering window. 2) Staging VPC peering prep: we will provide a BGP preview and expected route tables. 3) Appliance install window — we recommend a weekend night for minimal disruption. I've looped in Evelyn (SRE lead) and Ben (Implementation) to coordinate the technical runbook and schedule. See attached handoff checklist for a proposed tasking cadence. Best, Camila Reyes Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference camila_reyes@redwood.ai +1 (415) 555-0123 Attachments: ci-handoff-checklist.xlsx From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai To: Maya Reddy , camila_reyes@redwood.ai Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai Date: Tue, 11 Sep 2028 08:22:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Cerulean Systems: Private Deploy - connectivity & on-prem handoff Thanks Camila / Maya — Adding some technical detail that will help your network folks: - Peering model: We will establish a VPC peering between Cerulean staging VPC and Redwood-managed private VPC. Peering will be routed (no overlapping CIDRs). If you prefer a transit gateway, we can support that but it adds a short lead time for route configuration. - NAT/Egress: Appliance enrollment requires outbound 443; if using a corporate proxy, please allow TLS CONNECT for redwood-control.redwood.ai and our metrics endpoint metrics.redwood.ai:443. - IPs and prefixes: Redwood recommends allocating 10.50.8.0/24 for private endpoints and 10.50.16.0/24 for internal management. If you have any IP pools we should avoid, list them and we'll patch the plan. - Certificates/key exchange: For on-prem, we use mutual TLS during enrollment. We will provide PEM bundle and a short script to install the trust chain. Expect a one-time HSM keywrap if you're using KMS-backed HSM. I suggest a 30-minute technical call with your network engineer and proxy admin. Proposed slots: Wed 9/12 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu 9/13 16:00-16:30 PT. Which works for you? Cheers, Evelyn Hart Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference From: Maya Reddy To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai Cc: alex.chen@ceruleansystems.com, ben_carter@redwood.ai Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 15:37:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Cerulean Systems: Private Deploy - connectivity & on-prem handoff On Thu, 13 Sep 2028 09:22:00 -0700 evelyn_hart@redwood.ai wrote: > I suggest a 30-minute technical call with your network engineer and proxy admin. Proposed slots: Wed 9/12 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu 9/13 16:00-16:30 PT. Which works for you? Thanks — Thu 9/13 16:00 PT works best for our proxy admin. We reviewed the CIDR suggestions and can accommodate 10.50.0.0/16 with the exception of 10.50.16.0/24 (it is currently reserved). Please use 10.50.32.0/24 instead for the management range. Two quick items for the runbook: - Can Redwood provide a short pre-flight checklist we can run against our change control before the peering? Ideally a 10-step list that our change reviewers can sign off on. - For the on-prem appliance, do you have a fallback plan if our corporate proxy blocks the enrollment flow? We want an alternate bootstrap path (temporary NAT host or manual cert injection). We'll join the call Thursday; Alex will be on in case we need exec-level decisions. —Maya
